items.name: Hybird-PINN-Transformer-Model-for-Real-Time-Prediction-of-Space-Debris-Trajectory
items.description: A hybrid model combining PINN and transformers to enhance debris trajectory prediction by merging orbital physics with deep learning. This enables real-time, accurate collision risk assessment, improving satellite safety and space sustainability.

items.name: TE-PINN-Transformer-Enhanced-Physics-Informed-Neural-Network-Quaternion-Orientation-Estimation
items.description: A Transformer-Enhanced Physics-Informed Neural Network for accurate orientation estimation using IMU data. This repository integrates transformer networks with rigid body dynamics, multi-head attention, and RK4-based quaternion integration, optimized for embedded systems. TE-PINN reduces mean error by 36.8% and computational complexity by 25%.

items.name: piko-transformer
items.description: piko-transformer is the implementation of the 2017 paper "Attention Is All You Need" by Google Research. This repo was heavily inspired by Karpathy's famous "Let's Build GPT from Scratch" video.

items.name: pixi-transformer
items.description: Konva-style transform controls for PixiJS v8. Move, resize, rotate, flip, and multi-select Pixi display objects with editor-friendly anchors.

items.name: Pipeline-Transformer
items.description: A pipeline transformer in NLP is a way to chain multiple NLP models or processing steps together to perform a complex task. Think of it like an assembly line: data (text) enters at one end, goes through various stations (models/steps), and a finished product (processed text or output) emerges at the other.
